availability.note: The monthly archive bundle is published after each month ends (Last-Modified ~1 week later) and fetched post-evaluation, so no per-candle publication/availability timestamp is recorded. Completed Binance kline values are immutable (Binance does not revise finalized candles), which prevents future-data leakage into the close>open outcome, but strict point-in-time availability of each candle at its cutoff is NOT proven; the whole price experiment is a labelled retrospective benchmark.

Resolution truth is the pinned model/grid + captured response, not a station observation. IFS analysis can be revised after the fact, so a value fetched today for a past date is not proven to equal the value available at resolution time; the weather Outcome is a labelled retrospective benchmark.
Reanalysis for a past day can be revised after the fact; today’s value for a past date is not proven to equal the value available at the replay cutoff.

Run initialisation time precedes cutoff, but Open-Meteo does not record a per-run publication timestamp. Documented global-model latency is typically 4-6 hours (00 UTC run available ~04-06 UTC, before the 16:55 UTC cutoff), but that is an INFERENCE, not strict proof. Never the target day’s realized precipitation.
